coordinator_note: Every theoretical value read against its quotes. Pesah 2021: the stated limit on near-identity operators stays HIGH; Corollary 1 is cut before its Omega argument, Theorem 1 loses its inequality sign, layer symbol and path sum, Theorem 2 loses its numerator, Lemmas 2 to 5 are garbled or cut, and the rest are derivations or a proof quoted only by its conclusions. Pirnay 2022: the advantage statement with its RSA assumption, Theorem II.3 and the reduction Theorem IV.11 stay HIGH; the three quantum-efficiency theorems are cut before their bounds. Pirnay 2024: Theorem III.1 is cut before its sample bound, Theorem IV.1 before its advantage, and the rest are cited adaptations or proof steps. Qiao 2025: a claim under unstated optimal conditions. Qiu 2025: the stated limit on large tilt stays HIGH; Theorem 7 is cut before its conclusion, Theorem 8's exponent loses its numerator and its concentration step may omit a 1/gamma factor (reader inference), Theorem 10's limit loses its n and its tilt range is only 'a proven range', and the rest are informal, cited or derivation steps. Exponents printed flat are not counted as lost symbols
